```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(htmltools)

# Helper: section entry with right-aligned date
entry <- function(title, org, date, details = NULL) {
  tagList(
    div(class = "entry-header",
      span(class = "entry-title", title),
      span(class = "entry-date", date)
    ),
    div(class = "entry-org", org),
    if (!is.null(details)) tags$ul(lapply(details, tags$li))
  )
}

# Helper: simple line entry (for awards, certs, governance)
simple_entry <- function(title, org = NULL, date = NULL, note = NULL) {
  tagList(
    div(class = "entry-header",
      span(class = "entry-title", title),
      if (!is.null(date)) span(class = "entry-date", date)
    ),
    if (!is.null(org))  div(class = "entry-org", org),
    if (!is.null(note)) div(class = "entry-note", note)
  )
}

# Helper: education entry
edu_entry <- function(degree, year, institution, thesis = NULL, supervisor = NULL) {
  tagList(
    div(class = "entry-header",
      span(class = "entry-title", degree),
      span(class = "entry-date", year)
    ),
    div(class = "entry-org", institution),
    if (!is.null(thesis))     div(class = "entry-note", tags$em("Thesis: "), thesis),
    if (!is.null(supervisor)) div(class = "entry-note", tags$em("Supervisor: "), supervisor)
  )
}

divider <- function() div(class = "entry-divider")
```
